reason: I already ask ChatGPT or Claude for free and then place the trades myself, so I stay in control. I don't see why I'd pay every month to let a cartoon pet move my real money, especially when there's no price yet and the broker partner isn't even named.
objection: Who is liable if the agent loses money? A record I can download doesn't help me if my account is down, and with under $20k invested I can't afford to find out the hard way.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker with SIPC coverage holding the money, plus clear written terms on who pays if the agent makes a mistake, and a few months of me watching it on the demo account beat what I do by hand.
